name: Gemini
tagline: Google's AI already plugged into Gmail, Sheets and Drive
description: Google's AI assistant built into Workspace, with a huge context window, Google Search, deep research and YouTube integration.
priceNote: Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Companies already on Google Workspace that want AI inside email and spreadsheets
pros: Reads Gmail, Drive, Docs and Sheets directly, which removes the copy and paste
Huge context window for anyone working with databases and long reports
Deep research and Google Search integration deliver current data for analysis
Aggressively competitive API pricing, which helps teams embedding a model inside their product
cons: Answer quality fluctuates more than competitors, requiring human review on critical tasks
The feature list varies by region depending on the Google One or Workspace plan you have
The Ultra plan, from US$ 99.99/month, is too expensive for most small businesses and hard to justify
The Workspace integration only pays off if you already use Google; otherwise it is just another app

features.name: Workspace reading
features.detail: Opens Google email, documents and spreadsheets without copying and pasting

features.name: Huge context
features.detail: Processes documents and data volumes well above competitors' limits

features.name: Deep research
features.detail: Multi-stage report with Google Search and a research plan

features.name: Media generation
features.detail: Image, video and audio generated inside the same plan

features.name: Gemini API
features.detail: Low cost per token for embedding the model in your own product

useCases: Summarize the Gmail inbox and list the messages that need a customer reply
Cross the sales team's data with the shared Sheets file and produce the commission report
Research competitors and build a price comparison with source links
Extract data from scanned contracts and organize it into a shared spreadsheet
bestForWho: Companies that already live in Google Workspace and want to turn email and spreadsheets into the starting point for AI.
verdict: Gemini makes sense when the company already runs on Gmail, Sheets and Drive, because AI reads the material where the work actually happens, with no export step. Outside that scenario, the same money in ChatGPT or Claude goes further, because their answers tend to be more consistent for text work. Quality fluctuates more than competitors, so any flow that depends on a precise answer needs validation. For a small company, AI Pro under twenty dollars delivers the best return per dollar if the team is already on Google. For a larger company, look at the API instead of the subscription, because the price per token is among the lowest and lets you put an agent inside your product without spending a fortune.
